summary.text: William Beck is the Republican candidate for Minnesota House of Representatives District 41B in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Jen Fox; the Republican primary was canceled.
He is a Hastings resident and former teacher and charter school board member, according to his Ballotpedia survey.

paragraphs.text: William Beck earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Nebraska, Lincoln, and his career experience includes working as a technician, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is a husband and father of two and would draw on his experience as a former teacher, charter school board member and community volunteer.

Beck's survey listed affordability, accountability and academic excellence as his key messages, including capping property taxes, eliminating fraud, waste and abuse in state agencies, and cutting mandates on school districts.
He said he is passionate about education and human services, and that his eldest son's disability inspired him to run.
He said he wants to protect Medicaid-funded programs from fraud and to fix Minnesota's special education funding system.
